source: FBR Withholding Tax Rate Card · Tax Year 2027 (Finance Act 2026)
headline: OFF THE ATL?
WITHHOLDING TAX

blocks.text: Staying off the Active Taxpayers' List only costs a little.

items: **Independent professionals:** **15%** withheld on the ATL, **30%** off it
**New car, 1301–1600cc:** advance tax of **2%** of value, or **6%** off the ATL
**Cash withdrawals:** **0.8%** advance tax, charged only to people off the ATL
